diagnosis: The scorer tracebacks embed each randomly named TemporaryDirectory path. Rejections and diagnostic tails are stable, but hashing the complete unnormalized stderr makes the mutation receipt nondeterministic.
bounded_fix: Replace the temporary path in captured stderr with one fixed token before hashing it; preserve the unnormalized diagnostic tail and rejection result.
acceptance_test: Two independent mutation-driver executions must be byte-identical and all 13 named corruptions must still be rejected.
